experience.title: Work experience
experience.intro: Almost 4 years bringing data and AI into real products: at a startup, at a large public company and at a product company.

jobs.ctx: AI product company: we design our own solutions and sell them, mainly to public administrations and the security sector. We're a team of 4 developers running several products in parallel every sprint.

bullets.d: From the audio of a statement to a final document: speech transcription and structured data extraction with LLMs, turned into a product reusable across clients.
Citizen-service and medical-appointment bots built with LangGraph, a custom RAG and ElevenLabs voice. Each client tunes their own from a web dashboard, no code needed.
Prompts versioned in LangSmith, tests with expected outputs and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation to know whether a change makes the product better or worse.
AWS infrastructure with Terraform, CI/CD with GitHub Actions across three environments (dev, UAT and production), unit and end-to-end tests, and error alerts with Sentry.

hi.d: I temporarily took over product management: I created and prioritised tasks, planned sprints in Jira and tracked the team's work.
I research alternatives, such as multi-language support for a product, document them and bring them to the team so we can decide together.

jobs.ctx: Internal project to measure how much airtime each channel devotes to each topic: a figure reported to the broadcasting regulator that until then had not been calculated systematically.

bullets.d: We started from a need with no technical specification. Together with another data scientist, I designed the whole approach with a high degree of autonomy.
I spoke with each channel's content managers to understand their archives, and unified sources stored in different systems with different codes.
We pulled a full year of broadcast subtitles through APIs. We tried clustering and then moved to LLMs with a closed catalogue of categories, which gave more useful results.
A Power BI dashboard to filter by channel, topic, period and text, presented to several senior managers.

hi.d: Turning a question from leadership into a data system, working with non-technical people from different departments.

jobs.ctx: Startup accelerated by Lanzadera, building an AI-powered web product for popular history: pick a period and it returns key figures, dates, a summary and places on a map. I joined during the last semester of my degree.

bullets.d: I joined right after ChatGPT launched and followed the OpenAI API updates daily to bring them into the product.
Database modelling and the API endpoints powering the website, with my first cloud deployments (AWS and Azure).
Close collaboration with the front-end developer to align what the backend exposed with what users saw.

hi.d: I worked with external clients: meetings to understand their needs and tailor-made AI prototypes.

obrik.name: Obrik
obrik.kind: B2B SaaS · Founder and Product Engineer
obrik.cardLine: SaaS that lets renovation companies keep their clients updated, in real time, on how their project is going.
obrik.line: Software for renovation companies: it keeps their clients informed, in real time, of everything happening on their project.
obrik.spark: A full renovation involves a lot: one day the floor is replaced, another the tiles arrive, then the taps, then the furniture is fitted. I wanted clients to be able to follow it all without having to ask.
obrik.problem: In turnkey renovations, clients are constantly wondering what's been done and what's left, and information arrives through calls and scattered messages. With Obrik, the site manager uploads every update and the client sees it instantly: the company saves time and comes across as far more professional.

riset.name: RISET
riset.cardLine: Guided reflection app with themed cycles, one question a day and actionable challenges.
riset.line: Guided reflection app: themed cycles with one question a day and challenges to turn reflection into action.
riset.spark: It started with my business partner. We wanted to help people look after the pillars of everyday life (exercise, nutrition, reflection, meditation) and, after going round in circles a few times, we focused on a problem our own generation was living. Thinking it through as a pair led to much better ideas than either of us would have had alone.
riset.problem: We move very fast: endless stimuli, pressure to be productive and comparing ourselves on social media. It's hard to stop and reflect and, above all, to know what to reflect on; a blank journal doesn't help. RISET offers themed cycles lasting several weeks with a daily question shared by everyone, pulses (actionable challenges) and the option to share your progress with your network.
shotAlts: RISET: home screen with its four sections

vango.name: Vango
vango.cardLine: An art passport: a map of the world's must-see artworks where you tick off the ones you've seen.
vango.line: An art passport: a map of the world's must-see artworks where you tick off the ones you've seen and add your own.
vango.spark: I love travelling and art, and almost anywhere you go there's an iconic work: a painting, a sculpture, a mural or a building. I wanted to bring them all together on one map.
vango.problem: There was no single place to discover which artworks are worth seeing in each place and keep track of the ones you've already seen. Vango starts from a selection of must-see works I put together through my own research and, since art is subjective, lets you add your own with location, photo and description.

items.name: Neural networks for stocks
items.sub: Master's thesis · Inditex · GRU vs LSTM
items.figAlt: Actual versus predicted price from the best model (GRU)
blocks: Which neural network architecture best predicts the adjusted closing price of an IBEX 35 stock?
Inditex price history (yfinance) plus technical indicators: SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI, CCI, VWAP and Williams %R, in 5 combinations.
I compared RNN, LSTM, Conv1D-LSTM and GRU in two configurations each: 40 models evaluated with MAE, MSE and RMSE.
The GRU won using open, high, low, volume and close prices: an RMSE of 0.98, the lowest of all.
items.biz: Give investors quantitative signals to decide when to buy or sell. Next step: tune hyperparameters and add sentiment from financial news.

items.name: Hidden football gems
items.figAlt: Table: Real Madrid starting eleven and the most similar replacement for each player, with value and age
blocks: Can Real Madrid's 23/24 Champions League starting eleven be replicated with players any club could afford?
Dataset of players from the previous season with skills, market value and age, filtered to 28 or younger and €25M or less.
I chose the key skills for each position and, for each starter, found the most similar player using Euclidean distance. As an improvement, I suggest PCA to keep only what best explains performance.
A full alternative eleven worth €214.5M versus €692.5M for the original, 69% less. For example, Vinícius (€158.5M) → L. Bailey (€21M).
items.biz: Helps a sporting director sign players with sound criteria: finding diamonds in the rough with a playing style similar to big stars, at a fraction of the cost.

items.name: Júcar river floods
items.figAlt: Flow of the Rambla del Poyo on 29 October 2024 versus the 150 m³/s warning threshold
blocks: After the DANA storm of 29 October 2024 in Valencia: what did the flow data for the Rambla del Poyo say, and could the flood have been anticipated?
Five-minute flow data published by the Júcar River Basin Authority, plus the notification sent to Civil Protection.
I analysed the series against the 150 m³/s warning threshold and studied the first and second derivatives of the flow to detect the acceleration phases.

The upward trend started at 15:50 and the critical phase around 17:00, but Civil Protection wasn't notified until 18:43, with the flow ten times above the threshold. I also found a one-hour publication delay and inconsistencies in the data.
items.biz: Flow derivatives can work as an early-warning signal. And data only helps decision-making if it's published in real time and is consistent.
